Big black angular logo at bottom-right shrinks and travels up and left to sit beneath the wordmark; tiny handwritten 'mine' appears at its right at the end.

Same stick figure jumps from close-up to full-body wide scale in one frame, expression stays a smile, arms change from shrug to hands on hips; centred.
Hard cut from full-body stick figure to the medium-size black angular logo at centre.
Green dollar-sign money bags pop in around the black logo: one left bag, then trio left, then single and trio right by f2836; logo unchanged.
Hard cut from logo flanked by bag trios to the logo drawn as a character with legs, curved tail arm and a tan smartphone held at its right.
Hard cut from logo character with speech bubble to a centred stick figure with raised eyebrow, flat tilted mouth and one raised hand.
Same centred stick figure switches from sceptical frown and raised hand to a smile and open shrug arms; position unchanged.
Hard cut from stick figure to the black angular logo, centre-left, alone on white canvas.
Hard cut from two red-crossed groups to a photograph of nine adults standing in a row indoors, red corner icon top-left, handwritten caption bottom-right.
Hard cut from group photograph to white canvas with a blue-and-grey swirl logo and grey wordmark at top-left.
Hard cut from stacked logo cascade to a centred stick figure with closed smiling eyes and hands on hips.
Hard cut from stick figure to a timeline strip: '2023' centred then scrolling left to reveal red arrows and '2024', then '2025' centred.
Hard cut from timeline to dark news-search-result card at top with headline text, plus flaming money bags: pair at left, single at right.
Hard cut at f3478 from news card with burning bags to a centred stick figure with frown and one arm out right; f3475-3477 look unchanged to the eye.
Hard cut from frowning stick figure back to the nine-person group photograph with red corner icon and handwritten caption bottom-right.

Centre-left group photo of nine people in an office, red app icon top-left and handwritten caption '+ 2 more!' bottom-right, fades uniformly to near-white over 13 frames. Not sub-threshold noise; a real fade-out.
One frame inside the same fade-out: the ghosted group photo and '+ 2 more!' caption are already very pale and get slightly paler; no new content.
Final two frames of the fade: the last faint ghost of the group photo disappears and the canvas becomes pure blank white (stays blank until f3603).

A dark social-post screenshot card (centre-right, x0.38-0.93, y0.12-0.73; profile row, two-paragraph text, date line, reaction icons, 'Read 1.2K replies' bar) appears in one frame beside the unchanged character. Additive, not a replace.
One frame of logo assembly: the leftmost black shard has moved/vanished from the left and the X's left stroke is now complete; shards are joining into the logo.
Remaining shards (bar and right-hand fragments) snap together and the logo is assembled and recentred (x0.35-0.65): X plus slanted bar. Same subject, no new composition.
A small down-arrow and a value label above the hatched revenue bar draw on in 3 frames (label rises from clipped fragment to arrow plus text).
The '$24B' label above the revenue bar finishes resolving from a clipped fragment into full legible text; I-frame adds diffuse low-level noise over the chart bbox.
Solid green valuation bar grows upward from the baseline on the first column to near 1.00T with '$850B' label on top, and a speech bubble '~35x' appears below the logo.
Arrow and value label above the red-hatched bar draw on over 4 frames (dot, then arrow, then label rising into place).
The label above the red-hatched bar finishes resolving into legible '$30B'.
Red valuation bar grows from the baseline of the second column to '$400B' and a '~13x' speech bubble appears below its logo.
Arrow and '$1B' label draw on above a tiny sliver at the third column's baseline (x0.8, y0.62) over 7 frames.
Black valuation bar grows on the third column to '$250B' label above; adjacent '$1B' tag stays.
Black italic wordmark 'spirit' pops in horizontal at lower-right then rotates clockwise to a diagonal tilt (~45 deg) while the stick figure's right arm swings down.

Stick figure and logo replaced from f4712 by a small framed video cutaway (man at a podium, banknotes flying, flag at left) that shifts across the frame; a black wordmark appears above it near f4745; hard cut near f4763 to a centred smiling stick figure with arms out. Multiple sub-states, not one.

First carton slides off the left edge while cartons 2 and 3 slide left and re-centre (x0.28-0.73) over 8 frames.
Stick figure replaced by a vintage film-poster strip (left) and the carton labelled 'Business 2' enlarged at right (x0.5-0.88, y0.2-0.8); poster squeezes narrower and carton grows over 15 frames.
A cartoon rocket carrying a small seated passenger flies in from the right, passes in front of the open carton, then climbs up-left and exits at the top; heading and carton stay static.

Character and speech bubble replaced by a huge upright cartoon rocket that spins through several rotations while shrinking toward centre (16 frames); ends as a mid-size upright rocket with orange flame.
Rocket replaced by a very large cartoon Earth globe (green continents, navy sea, white ice) that bleeds the frame, then shrinks to a centred globe (x0.36-0.63, y0.26-0.74).
Satellite drifts roughly 10 px to the right over 40 frames in a slow float; globe unchanged. No new content.
A tiny rocket sits left of the globe for ~22 frames, then vanishes and a round multi-flag space-station mission patch (x0.12-0.29, y0.12-0.38) pops in at upper left.

Globe scene gains an astronaut figure (bottom), a blue-red space-agency roundel and four small satellites over ~100 frames, then a hard cut around f5551 to a news-article screenshot with wordmark and rocket.
Yellow highlighter sweeps left to right across the article line 'revenue was perhaps $4 billion last year' over 40 frames.
A flat-mouthed stick figure rises into the bottom-right over the chart (x0.68-0.82, y0.67-1.0), overlapping bottom bars.
Top-right quarter of the green circle separates and slides slightly out diagonally, becoming a pie slice with a white gap; rest of circle static.
Narrow poster strip disappears (slides/squeezes off at left) leaving the large carton 'Business 3' alone at centre.
Carton shrinks and moves up-right while a bald green-tie character with heart-shaped pink glasses slides in from the left edge (x0.05-0.2, y0.46-1.0).

Multi-state sequence: f6237 hard cut from heart-eyed scene to red 'The good' label, open carton 'Business 1' and a satellite carrying a small passenger; round black logo badge appears ~f6270; hard cut ~f6288 to full-bleed black card with white wordmark and lens flares (~2.4 s); hard cut ~f6346 back to white; black badge slides in at left.
Black round badge at left gains a blue-panel satellite (lower centre) and a cyan wifi-signal icon above it; at the end (~f6396) all replaced by a centred smiling stick figure.
Stick figure switches to an open-mouth grin with both arms raised and a small cartoon rocket appears at upper right (x0.69-0.82, y0.15-0.45); media logo stays.
